en.topic_title: Ex-Hong Kong care home warden found guilty of raping intellectually disabled female resident
en.topic_summary:
A former Hong Kong care home warden has been found guilty of raping an intellectually disabled female resident five times two years ago.



The High Court. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.



A High Court jury consisting of five men and two women on Wednesday found Chung Pui-kei, a former assistant warden at a Tai Po care home operated by the Hong Chi Association, guilty of five counts of rape, local media reported.
